entities.summary: Jan Rutta is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for Genève-Servette HC of the National League (NL). Originally an undrafted player, he won back-to-back Stanley Cups with the Tampa Bay Lightning in 2020 and 2021. Rutta has also previously played for the Chicago Blackhawks, Pittsburgh Penguins and San Jose Sharks.
